Preflight Demo Program
DOC-0008 2026-10-26
Friday Backlog Review With a Dated Carry List
POLICY
Effective date: 2026-10-26
Custodian: PERSON-0014, TEAM-0002
Scope: Recurring backlog review for DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA.
— Hold the Friday queue sweep at 09:10 and reserve twenty minutes for
backlog coordination. This edition formalizes the existing desk
appointment. Circulate topic headings before the meeting so that
owning-team leads can prepare useful decisions.
Review aging questions, missing ownership entries, absent reviewer
coverage, and administrative dependencies. Ask what action would move
each discussion forward. A backlog meeting should produce an owner and a
date, not simply repeat the preceding week's subject headings.
Keep priority proposals distinct from scheduling decisions. The chair may
arrange a discussion slot without changing a priority field. A proposed rank
change requires a written reason through the separate request process.
Maintain a dated carry list containing the locating reference, owning team,
next action, and next review date. Put parked background questions beside
their addressee and promised response date. A parked question must remain
visible when the main agenda advances.
End by reading the carry list to the receiving desk roles. Retain the prior list
alongside the new sheet so that deferred decisions remain traceable.
ISSUE-0014, TASK-0036, and TASK-0087 are references for the hydraulics
filing example, not a statement about backlog membership.
Revision note: This edition records the standing appointment and
standardizes the owner, action, and next-review columns.
D. Worker 0014
Demo Worker 0014, Demo Team 02
